case.summary: Alert HHF-018 was initiated after transaction 3612011 ($34.22) on card C02753-K1 generated a legacy real-time risk score of 0.8. In contrast, the bank's calibrated second-generation fraud model scored the transaction at 0.0 with a historical fraud rate of only 0.63%, providing strong evidence of legitimate activity. While the transaction was conducted through an anonymous proxy, the associated device profile is generic and unlinked to any fraud rings or suspicious clusters. Furthermore, the holder's baseline shows no card-testing sequence or compromised identity history, and prior similar risk-score alerts have consistently resolved as cleared. The transaction is determined to be legitimate cardholder activity and the case is closed with no fraud.
